name: Clodia
source:
In a royal system, there are always scores of minor nobles who make very few waves. Clodia is one of these, always staying out of notice, never getting caught up in the drama of the nobility. Instead, she’s dreamed of a peaceful and romantic life in a faraway land more than anything. When she met Valerius amidst the flames of war, it seemed as if that dream was going to come true. But now those flames have trapped her within Dagara, and only through her careful coordination with Valerius from the inside can she escape them and make her dream a reality.

[From [url=https://www.basileusgames.com/]official website[/url]]
